title: CMake+NSIS: Ship libunwind.dll with Stratoshark
description:
In 88c08992b3 we switched from Falco plugins written in Go to ones
written in Rust. The std crate on Windows requires libunwind:

https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/144533

Make sure we ship it with the Stratoshark NSIS installer, and add a
common FALCO_PLUGIN_DIR to the CMake environment to reduce duplicate code.

AI-Assisted: no
